title: かえる
checks: Title: kaeru is both 帰る (go home) and 変える/変わる (change), and the chorus plays on both
Lines 1-2: one clause split across lines (the stranger's face reflected in the window)
Lines 9 and 18: inverted, the object 君を comes after the verb
Lines 13-14: omitted subject is you, from line 3
Lines 6-9 and 15-18: the chorus repeats and is grouped the same way both times
